issue.body:
## Issue
Closes #6599

## Change
`JsonExtractorOutputGuardrail.validate()` reported every successful parse as a rewrite (`successWith(...)` → `SUCCESS_WITH_RESULT`). `OutputGuardrailExecutor` refuses retry/reprompt after a rewritten output (`Failure.blockRetry()`), so when several subclasses of the guardrail are chained, only the first one was ever able to reprompt — every later one silently turned a reprompt into `OutputGuardrailException: Retry or reprompt is not allowed after a rewritten output`.

This implements both directions from the issue:

1. **Only rewrite when the output actually changed.** `extractAndParseJson` returns the original text verbatim on its fast path, so `validate()` now compares the extracted JSON with the LLM response and returns a plain success when they are identical. JSON that had to be extracted from surrounding text is still rewritten to the extracted JSON.
2. **Added a payload-carrying plain-success factory.** New `OutputGuardrailResult.successWithResult(Object)` (plus a matching `OutputGuardrail` default method) produces a `SUCCESS` result that carries the deserialized object without marking the output as rewritten.

Observable change: for clean JSON, `result()` is now `SUCCESS` and `hasRewrittenResult()` is `false` (previously `SUCCESS_WITH_RESULT`/`true`). `successfulResult()` and `response(request)` behave exactly as before, so existing guardrails that read the deserialized object are unaffected. Guardrails that relied on the rewrite marker for clean JSON will now correctly allow subsequent retry/reprompt.

Also updated the guardrails tutorial: documented the new **_success with result_** outcome and the `JsonExtractorOutputGuardrail` behavior.

## General checklist
- [X] There are no breaking changes (API, behaviour)
- [X] I have added unit and/or integration tests for my change
- [X] The tests cover both positive and negative cases
- [X] I have manually run all the unit and integration tests in the module I have added/changed, and they are all green
- [ ] I have manually run all the unit and integration tests in the [core](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/tree/main/langchain4j-core) and [main](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/tree/main/langchain4j) modules, and they are all green
- [X] I have added/updated the [documentation](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/tree/main/docs)
- [ ] I have added an example in the [examples repo](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) (only for "big" features)
- [ ] I have added/updated [Spring Boot starter(s)](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/blob/main/langchain4j-spring-boot-starter/pom.xml) (if applicable)

Tests run: full `langchain4j-core` suite (1593 tests, 0 failures), full `langchain4j-guardrails` module (88 tests incl. the new `JsonExtractorOutputGuardrailChainTests`), `integration-tests/integration-tests-guardrails`, and the `*Guardrail*` tests in the main module. The new chain test fails on the pre-fix code with the exact exception from the issue.
